name: light_spear_flight
for: angel_priest lance of light (Motion::Shot 11/TPS); also usable for the_archangel at x0.86 (see light_spear_flight_archangel)
notes: A drawn winged spear of solid light (80 px, 1.5 m at the priest's 53.3 px/m): white core shaft with gold edges, a leaf blade with a white midrib, swept-back light barbs at the collar, a lit needle tip; a bright pulse runs up the shaft toward the blade, hard 4-point glints flick on the blade and shaft, short gold speed lines behind. Anchor = spear centre.
